calibration_sources: NVIDIA Multi-Node NVLink (MNNVL), IMEX Service (`nvidia-imex`) & `/dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels` Documentation
NVIDIA K8s DRA Driver (`ComputeDomain` CRD) & NMX-C (NVLink Management Controller) Fabric Partitioning Guides

workload.rack_architecture: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 Rack Supernode (18 Compute Trays × 4 B200 GPUs = 72 GPUs, 9 NVSwitch Trays, 130 TB/s NVLink-5 Copper Backplane)
workload.imex_mechanism: Because 18 trays run 18 separate Linux OS kernels, POSIX fd IPC fails across trays; nvidia-imex daemon exchanges fabric memory handles over TCP/IP and authorizes GPU MMU mappings via /dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels/channelN
workload.security_and_fallback_risks: 1) Unmounted IMEX channel device causes silent fallback from 900 GB/s/dir NVLink-5 to 50 GB/s NIC; 2) Sharing channel0 across tenants allows any tenant to import peer HBM handles!

tiers.name: Tier 1: 容器未挂载 IMEX 通道或 `nvidia-imex` 异常 (静默回退至网卡 RDMA · 带宽暴跌 16.2x ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Unmounted IMEX Channel / Daemon Mismatch (Silent Fallback to RoCE/IB NIC = 16.2x Bandwidth Drop)
tiers.recommended_for: Broken configuration trap! Paying for a $3M+ GB200 NVL72 copper backplane while accidentally running cross-tray collectives over 400G/800G Ethernet/IB.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 全柜共享默认 `channel0` + 单一全局 NVLink 域 (跑满 780 GB/s，但跨租户显存 100% 裸奔 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Shared Global `channel0` + Single Rack Partition (780 GB/s BusBW, 100% Cross-Tenant HBM Breach Risk)
tiers.recommended_for: Strictly single-tenant 72-GPU monolithic pretraining jobs; fatal in multi-tenant clouds (shared channel0 permits cross-tenant cuMemImportFromShareableHandle).

tiers.name: Tier 3: K8s DRA `ComputeDomain` 动态分配每作业独立 `IMEX channelN` (零跨租户显存泄露 ✅)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: K8s DRA `ComputeDomain` Per-Job Ephemeral `IMEX channelN` Isolation (0% Cross-Tenant HBM Leak)
tiers.recommended_for: Multi-job internal enterprise GB200 clusters isolating each distributed job into a unique Linux capability channel (/dev/nvidia-caps-imex-channels/channelN).

tiers.name: Tier 4: K8s DRA 独立 IMEX 通道 + NMX-C 硬件级 NVSwitch 分区隔离 (硬件防泄露 + 故障域收敛 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: K8s DRA Ephemeral IMEX + NMX-C Hardware NVSwitch Partitioning (Hardware Isolation & Contained Blast Radius)
tiers.recommended_for: Production multi-tenant GB200 NVL72 AI clouds: enforces both OS IMEX channel isolation and NVSwitch silicon access-control tables.
